entities.name: Cerys Awbrey
entities.description: A Shadowmoor elf who inherits her late uncle Gethin's house and begins a correspondence with Rhain; she is petrified in the eclipsed realm.

entities.name: Gethin
entities.description: Cerys's late uncle, a bloomseeker and healer who refused to give Rhain dawnglove and hid a stem of it.

entities.name: Rhain Breckon
entities.description: A Lorwyn elf scarred by a boggart in an eclipsed realm and slowly calcifying, who corresponds with Cerys and dies with her.

entities.name: Reliquary of Twilight
entities.description: Gethin's bell-shaped lantern reliquary, which lets Cerys cross the aurora until it breaks.

entities.name: Dawnglove
entities.description: A sacred Shadowmoor flower that is the only cure for Rhain's ailment.

entities.name: Nightphlox
entities.description: A balsam flower that grows only in Shadowmoor and is good for healing salves.

entities.name: Aurora
entities.description: The shifting border between Lorwyn and Shadowmoor and the eclipsed realm where living things calcify.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The night aspect where Cerys lives.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The day aspect where Rhain lives.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: The elf city to which Rhain cannot return in his scarred state.

entities.name: Caer Flur
entities.description: A city in Shadowmoor in the opposite direction from the aurora.

entities.name: Boggarts
entities.description: A boggart attacked Rhain and scarred him.

events.summary: Cerys enters her late uncle Gethin's decayed house and finds the Reliquary of Twilight broken.
events.quote: The Reliquary of Twilight hadn't been used much in her uncle's final months

events.summary: Cerys finds an unsent letter and a parcel of balsam salve addressed to Rhain Breckon.
events.quote: The tag was addressed to a "Mr. Rhain Breckon."

events.summary: Cerys writes to Rhain to tell him of Gethin's death and sends the letter and parcel by enchanted paper wing toward the aurora.
events.quote: Not left, toward the city of Caer Flur, but right —toward the aurora.

events.summary: Rhain and Cerys trade rude letters, with Rhain calling Gethin a coward.
Cerys softens, picks nightphlox for Rhain and sends him a salve recipe; Rhain thanks her.
events.quote: Vanity was in Rhain's nature; helping was in hers.

events.summary: Rhain tells Cerys he met Gethin the day the aurora shifted, when a boggart attacked him and Gethin rescued him.
events.quote: I would never have made it out if Gethin hadn't been there.

events.summary: Rhain, calcifying and hiding from the elves of Lys Alana, decides not to ask Cerys for dawnglove and instead asks to keep corresponding.
events.quote: Very soon, the mark would calcify his heart, and he would die.

events.summary: Cerys finds a hidden stem of dawnglove and an unsent letter that shows Gethin almost gave it to Rhain.
events.quote: This is what Rhain had asked Uncle Gethin for , she realized

events.summary: Rhain writes his final letter confessing his feelings for Cerys and collapses.
events.quote: You, Cerys, are the very best part of my day.

events.summary: Cerys crosses the aurora and feeds Rhain dawnglove, reviving him.
events.quote: You fed me dawnglove. You crossed the aurora.

events.summary: Cerys's broken reliquary fails, and she turns on Rhain with cruel words as the Morningtide changes her.
events.quote: No wonder you were afraid of being cast out,

events.summary: Rhain carries the calcifying Cerys toward the border, but she turns to stone from the waist down as they enter the aurora.
events.quote: Cerys was stone from the waist down.

events.summary: Cerys tells Rhain his scars are beautiful, and Rhain, calcifying beside her, refuses to leave.
events.quote: For what it's worth, I think your scars are beautiful.

events.summary: Rhain and Cerys turn to stone in each other's arms in the eclipsed realm.
events.quote: as Rhain and Cerys turned to stone in each other's arms.

relations.quote: willing the last of his belongings to Cerys—the only blood relative he had left.

relations.note: They fall in love through letters.
relations.quote: whatever your appearance, it holds no weight in what I feel for you.

relations.note: Gethin tended Rhain's wounds and became his friend.
relations.quote: Over the months we became friends, at a time when I had lost all others.

relations.note: A boggart attacked and scarred Rhain.

relations.quote: There had been no tales of his adventures as a bloomseeker

relations.note: The reliquary was Gethin's most treasured belonging.
relations.quote: to see his most treasured belonging in such a broken state

rejected.summary: Cerys asks Rhain if he is dying and he answers that he is.
